caption:
Why are some GLP-1 drugs weekly?

Natural GLP-1 is broken down within minutes. Semaglutide and tirzepatide are built to last much longer, which is why they are used weekly. Did you know this? Yes or no.

More at pepsafe.info/p/semaglutide.html
